simple.summary: מְרֹדָךְ (Mᵉrôdâk) means Merodak , a Babylonian idol First listed occurrence: Jer 50 2.

definitions.full: H4781. Merodak מְרֹדַךְ proper name, of a divinity chief god of Babylon in Nebuchadrezzar's time (Assyrian Mar(u)duk(u) Schr COT Gloss Tiele Babylonian -Ass. Geschichte. 530 ff. Say Rel. Babylonian 96 ff.; compare Muss-Arn JBL xi. 1892, 164 f. ); — מְרֹדָ֑ךְ חַת בֵּל הֹבִישׁ בָּבֶל נִלְכְּדָת Jer 50:2 ( ᵐ5 Μαιωδακ ).
